headline: Gannon stay top as Lock Haven lose at home
dek: Gannon beat Shepherd while Lock Haven, who had beaten Gannon in their previous match, lost at home to E. Stroudsburg. That leaves Lock Haven level on points with West Chester and Millersville behind the leaders, and Gannon with twelve wins, three draws and three defeats across the season.
displaced_by: Gannon beat Shepherd and Lock Haven lost to E. Stroudsburg; the standing dek's eleven Gannon wins is no longer true.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Gannon have scored more than California (Pa.) and Shippensburg together and conceded 23, so the tallest bar stands on attack: theirs is a lead in goals scored, not in goals kept out.

wire.line: Millersville have won thirteen matches and conceded 14 goals, yet sit behind Gannon in the table.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shepherd's home match against District of Columbia is the one date on the record that has passed with no result, and it is Shepherd's alone.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pitt-Johnstown have conceded 48 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, and have won one match, drawn two and lost thirteen.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lock Haven have drawn nine matches, more than any other programme in the conference, against six wins and four defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jaden Howard has kept eight shutouts in goal for West Chester.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Rafael Santos has six goals and eight assists from 54 shots for Seton Hill.

last_match.line: E. Stroudsburg ended a run without a win that went back to their victory at Shepherd.

next_match.line: Seton Hill have yet to beat Gannon this season: a draw at Gannon, then a Gannon win at Seton Hill.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
